title: Constraint: Array Sum
constraints: Write a class `sum_item` with `rand bit [7:0] arr[8];`.
Every call to `randomize()` must give: the 8 elements (as integers) sum to exactly **200**, every element is between **5 and 60** inclusive, and `arr[0]` is **even**.
Results must be genuinely random. Across 300 calls the testbench expects plenty of distinct arrays and a spread of values at every index.
Runs on Verilator, which needs the `z3` solver installed (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: `arr.sum() with (int'(item)) == 200`: casting each item to `int` guarantees a full-width sum. By the LRM, `sum()` of 8-bit elements is only 8 bits wide, and some simulators really do wrap.
